rationale: The study examines objective and subjective indicators of general urban quality of life in Switzerland—specifically safety in public spaces, green space loss, traffic congestion, fear of crime, and spatial access to central urban facilities—with no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings because the study is completely off-topic (E01), examining urban quality of life, public space safety, and spatial access to central urban facilities in Switzerland rather than water or sanitation services.

evidence_quotes.quote: Structural equation models were calibrated to examine the direct and indirect effects of important indicators of urban QoL, namely safety in public spaces and access to central urban facilities.
threats to the local QoL (e.g., loss of green spaces, traffic congestions, and fear of crime).
